In this video, we break down why advanced manufacturing could be India’s next big economic shiftespecially in a post-AI world where traditional IT jobs are slowing down.
Using Accel India’s Advanced Manufacturing Report 2025, we cut through the buzzwords and look at what’s actually changing on the ground.
In this breakdown, we cover:
• What advanced manufacturing really means
• Why electronics manufacturing is scaling so fast in India
• The role of government incentives and China+1
• Where real jobs and long-term value are being created
